title: Rav Shmuel bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a student of Rav Papa, as in Nazir 51b, where he raised a difficulty against Rav Papa.
And in Menachot 34 and Chullin 91a he spoke before Rav Papa in the name of Rava bar Ulla.
And in Yoma 37a the text reads: "Rav Shmuel bar Papa explained it before Rav Ada"; it should read Rav Shmuel bar Acha before Rav Papa, as in Dikdukei Soferim.
In Bava Metzia 46 and Bava Batra 77b and 150b, Rav Papa assigned the money to Rav Shmuel bar Acha. When Shmuel returned, Rav Papa went out to meet him as far as Torkh.
Bava Kamma 104b mistakenly reads Rav Shmuel bar Abba.
And likewise he is mentioned in Bava Kamma 99a resolving the words of Rav Sheshet.

notes.text: The supplied place-name תורך is retained as Torkh; the checked Bava Batra reads תווך, Tavakh. Hyman’s corrections to the Shmuel/Acha/Papa chain remain attributed.

The inspected Bava Batra 77b directly names Shmuel bar Acha as recipient of Rav Papa’s assigned money and reads Tavakh. Hyman’s Torkh and the exact Dikdukei Soferim corrections to the Papa/Acha/Abba chains remain distinct reported readings.
